title: 注意力感知路由：在MoE中耦合路由与注意力机制
summary: 提出注意力感知路由（AAR），利用注意力权重滑动窗口提取的时序与频谱特征增强MoE路由器，在冻结基础Transformer的情况下仅训练路由参数。在OLMoE上GSM8K提升3.37个百分点，并揭示路由与注意力形成耦合回路，且具有深度敏感性。
summary_en: Proposes Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments the MoE router with temporal and spectral features from a sliding window of attention weights. Keeping the base transformer frozen, only routing parameters are trained. AAR improves GSM8K by +3.37 pp on OLMoE and reveals a coupled routing-attention circuit with strong depth sensitivity.
